spells.description: You pursue your prey with supernatural persistence, ignoring all obstacles. For 2 rounds, your movement cannot be reduced, you automatically pass all STR saves to resist being slowed, and you deal +1d6 damage on each hit.

spells.name: Heart Strike
spells.description: A crushing blow aimed directly at the enemy's core. Deals 3d8 + STR bludgeoning damage and reduces the target's maximum HP by 5 until they rest.

spells.name: Predator's Ambush
spells.description: Channeling the instincts of a stalking predator, you strike from your blind spot. If you attack from a tile the target has not observed, the attack is an automatic critical and the target is Surprised for 1 round.

spells.name: Trail of the Prey
spells.description: You mark your enemy with ancestral hunting magic. For 3 rounds, your attacks against the marked target gain Advantage and deal +1d8 bonus damage.

spells.name: Wolf's Claw
spells.description: Three rapid claw-like slashes that tear flesh and break will. Deals 3 × 1d6 + STR slashing damage; if all three hit, the target is Bleeding for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Hunter's Judgment
spells.description: You channel the judgment of the hunt, striking with unavoidable certainty. Your next attack this turn automatically hits and deals 4d6 + STR damage.

spells.name: Rite of Strength
spells.description: A sacred ritual that awakens the strength of your ancestors. For 3 rounds, your melee attacks deal maximum damage on all dice.

spells.name: Blessing of the Ancestors
spells.description: The spirits of your fallen ancestors empower you in battle. Remove all conditions from yourself, regain 3d8 HP, and gain +3 to all saving throws for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Seal of Blood
spells.description: You trace an ancient blood-seal on yourself, binding your spirit to battle. For 2 rounds, you cannot die from damage (HP cannot go below 1) and all your attacks deal double damage dice.

spells.name: Pact with the Beast
spells.description: You call upon your inner beast and temporarily fuse with it. For 3 rounds, your unarmed attacks deal 2d8 + STR damage, you have Advantage on all STR checks and saves, and you gain Resistance to bludgeoning damage.

spells.name: Rite of Thunder
spells.description: A thunderous ritual strike that channels storm energy through your weapon. Deals 4d8 + STR thunder damage and knocks all enemies within 2 tiles of the target Prone (STR save DC 16 to resist).

spells.name: Honor of the Clan
spells.description: You invoke the name of your clan and fight with the fury of your entire bloodline. For 3 rounds, all damage you deal is increased by 50%, and you cannot be Frightened or Charmed.

spells.name: Primal Frenzy
spells.description: You enter an absolute primal frenzy, transcending pain and exhaustion entirely. For 2 rounds, make 3 attacks per round, each dealing 2d10 + STR damage; you gain Immunity to all conditions during this time.

spells.name: Form of the Beast
spells.description: Your body reshapes itself into a half-beast war form. For 3 rounds, gain +4 STR, natural AC 16, Resistance to all non-magical damage, and your unarmed attacks deal 3d6 + STR damage.

spells.name: Strike of Judgment
spells.description: The earth itself shakes as you bring down your weapon with the weight of your ancestors' wrath. Deals 5d10 + STR damage to a single target; if this kills the target, all enemies within 3 tiles must make a WIS save (DC 17) or be Frightened for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Roar of the Ancient
spells.description: A primal roar that echoes across all of existence. All enemies on the current floor must make a WIS save (DC 17) or be Frightened for 2 rounds. Allies on the floor are inspired and gain +3 to all rolls for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Blood and Fury
spells.description: The apex of barbarian rage, where blood becomes power. For 3 rounds, every HP of damage you take fuels a +1d4 bonus to your next attack (stacking), and your attacks automatically Crit on a roll of 15 or higher.

spells.name: Awakening of the Predator
spells.description: The primal predator sleeping inside you awakens completely. For 2 rounds, you gain Truesight (ignoring all illusions and invisibility), your attacks bypass all Resistance and Immunity, and you deal 3d10 + STR damage per strike.

spells.name: Silent Step
spells.description: You move with perfect silence, leaving no trace of your passage. Move up to 3 tiles without triggering enemy detection checks. Grants Advantage on your next attack made this turn.

spells.name: Backstab
spells.description: A precise stab into the back of an unaware or flanked target. Deals 2d6 + DEX piercing damage. If the target is Surprised, Blinded, or flanked, deal an additional 2d6 sneak attack damage.

spells.name: Eye of the Shadow
spells.description: You read the shadows around a target, predicting their next movement. For 2 rounds, you cannot be surprised and your attacks against this target have Advantage.

spells.name: Night Slip
spells.description: You blend into nearby shadows and slip behind an enemy in one fluid motion. Move up to 3 tiles, passing through enemies, and become Hidden until your next attack.

spells.name: Quick Lunge
spells.description: A darting stab launched from concealment. Deals 1d8 + DEX piercing damage. If used from a Hidden state, automatically deals sneak attack bonus damage (2d6).

spells.name: Vanish in the Shadow
spells.description: You dissolve into the nearest shadow, becoming completely undetectable. Gain the Hidden status for 3 rounds or until you attack.

spells.name: Hands of Silk
spells.description: Your fingers move with imperceptible delicacy, picking pockets, disabling traps, or adjusting equipment without detection. Grants Advantage on any Sleight of Hand action this turn.

spells.name: Lock's Touch
spells.description: With a practiced touch, you read a lock's mechanism by feel alone. Unlocks any standard lock in one action without tools. For magical locks, grants Advantage on the lockpicking roll.

spells.name: Quick Disengage
spells.description: You slip out of melee range with practiced ease. Move up to 3 tiles away from an adjacent enemy without provoking opportunity attacks and immediately become Hidden.

spells.name: Eye for Locks
spells.description: Your trained eye spots weaknesses in locking mechanisms at a glance. Automatically identify the difficulty and type of any lock or trap within 2 tiles.

spells.name: Silent Maneuver
spells.description: A perfectly timed repositioning that leaves enemies confused about your location. Move up to 2 tiles; enemies must make a WIS check (DC 14) or lose track of your position.

spells.name: Skeleton Key
spells.description: Using a combination of improvised tools and trained touch, you bypass virtually any lock. Unlocks any non-artifact lock and disables any non-magical trap automatically.

spells.name: Trap Disarm
spells.description: Steady hands and sharp eyes allow you to neutralize any trap safely. Automatically disarm any non-magical trap within reach without triggering it.

spells.name: Spring Device
spells.description: You rig a trap to trigger on contact with your chosen target. The next enemy to step in or near the designated tile takes 2d8 piercing damage and is Immobilized for 1 round.

spells.name: Pocket Spear
spells.description: You produce a concealed blade from an unlikely hiding spot, catching the enemy completely off guard. Deals 1d8 + DEX piercing damage. Counts as a sneak attack if conditions are met; enemy cannot react to this attack.

spells.name: Snap Mechanism
spells.description: You trigger an existing trap or environmental hazard remotely, directing it at an enemy within range. Deals damage according to the trap type (minimum 2d6).

spells.name: Nets and Snares
spells.description: You deploy a collapsible net, entangling an adjacent enemy. The target is Paralyzed for 2 rounds (STR save DC 14 each round to break free).

spells.name: Perfect Bait
spells.description: You create a convincing distraction that draws enemies to a specific location. One enemy within 4 tiles must make a WIS save (DC 14) or move toward the distraction, ignoring other targets for 1 round.

spells.name: Serpent's Poison
spells.description: You apply a fast-acting contact poison to your weapon. Your next hit deals 2d6 extra poison damage and inflicts the Poisoned condition for 3 rounds (CON save DC 15 to resist Poisoned).

spells.name: Spider's Toxin
spells.description: A rare spider toxin coats your blade, causing muscle paralysis. Your next hit deals 1d8 poison damage and Paralyzes the target for 1 round (CON save DC 15 negates paralysis).

spells.name: Drop of Death
spells.description: A single drop of a lethal distillation introduced into a target's drink or food. If ingested, deals 4d8 poison damage over 3 rounds. Can also be applied to a weapon for 2d8 contact poison damage.

spells.name: Poisonous Mist
spells.description: You shatter a vial of aerosolized toxin in a 2-tile radius. All creatures in the area must make a CON save (DC 14) or take 2d6 poison damage and be Poisoned for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Poisoned Hook
spells.description: A curved blade coated in a persistent toxin that is nearly impossible to clean from a wound. Deals 1d6 piercing damage plus 1d6 poison damage per round for 4 rounds (CON save DC 15 each round to end early).

spells.name: Secret Antidote
spells.description: You administer a carefully prepared antidote, curing any poison or toxic condition. Can be used on yourself or an adjacent ally. Also grants 2 rounds of Poison Immunity.

spells.name: Stairway of Shadows
spells.description: You chart a path through the network of shadows in the dungeon. Instantly teleport to any tile in the current room you have visited, bypassing all obstacles.

spells.name: Secret Passage
spells.description: Drawing on your deep knowledge of dungeon architecture, you find hidden passages others would never notice. Reveal and traverse a hidden shortcut in the current floor, moving to an adjacent room.

spells.name: Perfect Camouflage
spells.description: You apply dyes and shadow-skills to become one with your environment. Gain the Hidden status for 5 rounds, even while moving. You can attack once without breaking camouflage.

spells.name: Silent Entry
spells.description: Every sound you make, every footstep and breath, is completely suppressed. For 3 rounds, you cannot be detected by hearing-based senses and all your movement is completely silent.

spells.name: Identity Swap
spells.description: Using a masterwork disguise and behavioral mimicry, you temporarily impersonate another creature. Enemies who lack True Sight will treat you as a neutral or friendly entity for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Quick Escape
spells.description: When cornered or in critical danger, you trigger a pre-planned escape route. Move up to 6 tiles instantly, passing through enemies and obstacles, and become Hidden for 2 rounds at the destination.

spells.name: Guild Protocol
spells.description: You execute a coordinated Guild operation, calling on embedded assets. One enemy within 5 tiles is marked: all attacks against them have Advantage and deal +2d6 sneak attack damage for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Master's Strike
spells.description: The definitive technique of the shadow operative — a strike too fast to see and too precise to survive. Deals 6d8 + DEX damage and applies all of the following: Blinded, Poisoned, Bleeding (3 rounds each).

spells.name: Network of Contacts
spells.description: You send a signal through your intelligence network. Reveal the location of all enemies on the current floor for 3 rounds. Enemies cannot detect you for the same duration.

spells.name: Silent Order
spells.description: A whispered code activates a sleeper agent or contact in the current location. One enemy on the floor is Neutralized (removed from combat) for 3 rounds, as if they never existed.

spells.name: Contract of Death
spells.description: You invoke a Guild death contract on a target. For 5 rounds, the target takes 2d10 necrotic damage per round and cannot heal by any means. If the target dies while under the contract, you gain 50% of their remaining HP.

spells.name: Legacy of the Shadow
spells.description: The ultimate technique of the Guild's greatest assassins, passed down through generations. Your next attack deals 8d10 + DEX damage, is an automatic critical hit, bypasses all Resistance and Immunity, and leaves the target Poisoned and Bleeding for 5 rounds.

spells.name: Ancestral Totem Call
spells.description: You call upon the great totem of your ancestors. Spirit-fire blazes in your eyes and the path between the surface world and the deepest place your people have ever ventured opens before you. If you stand on the surface, the totem drags you down to the lowest level your tribe has explored; if you are deep below, its light guides you back up into the sunlight.

spells.name: The Last Refrain
spells.description: You sing the final verse of a great epic. The melody folds space like a page being turned, and when the last note fades you stand where the story ends: on the surface, or at the deepest place your company has ever explored.

spells.name: Divine Recall
spells.description: You kneel and pray to your deity. A pillar of divine light descends and recalls you along the sacred road that links your temple's threshold with the deepest ground your faith has ever consecrated.

spells.name: The Green Path
spells.description: You whisper to the old green things. Roots and moss braid themselves into a living stairway spanning the layers of the world, carrying you from the surface down to the deepest root your people have ever touched - or back up into the sunlight.

spells.name: Warrior's March
spells.description: You close your eyes and count the steps of a thousand campaigns. The discipline of the march folds the distance between the gate and the deepest level you have ever conquered, and you arrive as if you had simply walked there.

spells.name: Flowing Step
spells.description: You breathe in, and for one heartbeat you are neither here nor there. The Way flows between the surface and the deepest place you have ever walked, and you step across it as water crosses stone.

spells.name: Oathbound Passage
spells.description: You speak your oath aloud. A bridge of radiant light spans the distance between your temple's doorstep and the deepest ground your order has ever sworn to defend.

spells.name: Hunter's Trail
spells.description: You read the tracks in the stone. Every hunter knows that the deepest trail leads to the deepest lair, and the lair always leads back home. You follow it, and the world falls away.

spells.name: The Back Door
spells.description: Every vault, every keep, every dungeon has a back door - and you have found them all. You slip through the shadow of one and out the other: from the surface to the deepest place you have ever picked a lock, or back again.

spells.name: Bloodline Rift
spells.description: The magic in your blood surges and tears a rift in the fabric of the world. Through it you glimpse the surface and the deepest level you have ever touched, and you step through before the wound closes.

spells.name: Pact Passage
spells.description: Your patron's mark burns on your palm and a gate of shadowed fire swings open. The terms of the pact are clear: you may travel between the surface and the deepest place your pact has ever led you, at will.

spells.name: Arcane Transit
spells.description: You inscribe a transit sigil in the air and solve the geometry of the world's layers. Reality complies: you are translated instantly between the surface and the deepest level you have ever charted.
